title: StatD2GAN: A Protocol-Correction and Component Analysis of Multi-Discriminator GANs for Synthetic Weather Sequences
description: A multi-discriminator GAN for synthetic multivariate weather sequences and a held-out re-evaluation that overturns most of its own architecture claims. Code, ablation results, and figures for the StatD2GAN v2 campaign (5 locations, 9 ablation arms x 5 seeds, 2 baselines x 25 runs, held-out evaluation protocol).
